nodes.name: Configure RFx Assistant
nodes.notes: Edit the workbook ID, sourcing-manager email, and optional thresholds directly in this Set node. No n8n Variables are required.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;
const event = d.eventRecord || {};
const faq = d.authorizedFaqMatches || [];

const eventContext = {
  Event_ID: event.Event_ID || '',
  Event_Name: event.Event_Name || '',
  Event_Type: event.Event_Type || '',
  Status: event.Status || '',
  Stage: event.Stage || '',
  Start_Date: event.Start_Date || '',
  Submission_Deadline: event.Submission_Deadline || '',
  Evaluation_Start: event.Evaluation_Start || '',
  Award_Date: event.Award_Date || '',
  Contact_Person: event.Contact_Person || '',
  Contact_Email: event.Contact_Email || '',
  Eligibility_Criteria: event.Eligibility_Criteria || '',
  Submission_Format: event.Submission_Format || '',
  Description: event.Description || ''
};

const prompt = `You are a grounded RFx sourcing FAQ assistant. Return ONLY valid JSON.

Output schema:
{
  "answer": "concise answer, max 220 words",
  "used_faq_ids": ["FAQ-..."],
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "needs_human": false,
  "follow_up": "",
  "grounding_note": "short explanation of which supplied facts support the answer"
}

NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES:
1. Use ONLY EVENT_CONTEXT and AUTHORIZED_FAQ_CONTEXT below.
2. Never invent dates, requirements, links, evaluation details, pricing, contacts, or contract terms.
3. The authoritative event stage is EVENT_CONTEXT.Stage. Do not infer a different stage from the user's wording.
4. You are answering a ${d.requestorType.toUpperCase()}. Do not reveal information for the other audience.
5. Only cite FAQ IDs that exist in AUTHORIZED_FAQ_CONTEXT.
6. If the supplied context is insufficient, set needs_human=true and explain the gap instead of guessing.
7. Do not disclose competitor bids, bidder scores/rankings, confidential evaluation detail, negotiation strategy, or legal advice.
8. Adapt the wording to the current event stage: ${d.eventStage}.
9. If a deadline/date is included, copy it exactly from EVENT_CONTEXT.

EVENT_CONTEXT:
${JSON.stringify(eventContext)}

AUTHORIZED_FAQ_CONTEXT:
${JSON.stringify(faq)}

USER_QUESTION:
${JSON.stringify(d.queryText)}`;

return [{json:{...d, answerPrompt:prompt}}];

const d = $json;
const finalResponse = d.followUp ? `${d.generatedAnswer}\n\n${d.followUp}` : d.generatedAnswer;
return [{json:{
  Interaction_ID:d.interaction_id,
  Timestamp:d.received_at,
  Session_ID:d.session_id,
  Question_Asked:d.queryText,
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType,
  Intent:d.intent,
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId,
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage,
  Route:'ANSWERED',
  FAQ_Best_Score:d.faqBestScore,
  FAQ_IDs_Used:(d.usedFaqIds||[]).join(', '),
  AI_Confidence:d.answerConfidence,
  Repeat_Question_Count:d.repeatQuestionCount,
  Was_Escalated:'No',
  Escalation_Reason:'',
  Answer_Given:finalResponse,
  Grounding_Note:d.groundingNote,
  final_response:finalResponse
}}];

const d=$json;
return [{json:{
  Gap_ID:d.gap_id,
  Timestamp:d.received_at,
  Session_ID:d.session_id,
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId,
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage,
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType,
  Intent:d.intent,
  Question:d.queryText,
  Best_FAQ_Score:d.faqBestScore,
  Repeat_Question_Count:d.repeatQuestionCount,
  Priority:d.gap_priority,
  Status:d.gap_status
}}];

const d=$('Prepare Knowledge Gap').item.json;
return [{json:{
  Candidate_ID:'FAQ-CAND-' + $execution.id + '-' + Date.now(),
  Created_At:d.received_at,
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId,
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage,
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType,
  Intent:d.intent,
  Repeated_Question:d.queryText,
  Frequency:d.repeatQuestionCount,
  Suggested_Category:d.intent,
  Status:'Needs Sourcing Review',
  Proposed_Action:'Review repeated unanswered question and add an approved FAQ entry if appropriate.'
}}];

const d=$json;
return [{json:{
  Interaction_ID:d.interaction_id,
  Timestamp:d.received_at,
  Session_ID:d.session_id,
  Question_Asked:d.queryText,
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType,
  Intent:d.intent,
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId || d.eventIdHint || '',
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage,
  Route:'CLARIFICATION',
  FAQ_Best_Score:'',
  FAQ_IDs_Used:'',
  AI_Confidence:'',
  Repeat_Question_Count:'',
  Was_Escalated:'No',
  Escalation_Reason:d.clarificationReason,
  Answer_Given:d.final_response,
  Grounding_Note:'No answer generated until identity/event context is resolved.',
  final_response:d.final_response
}}];

const d=$json;
return [{json:{
  Escalation_ID:d.escalation_id,
  Timestamp:d.received_at,
  Session_ID:d.session_id,
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId || d.eventIdHint || '',
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage || '',
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType || 'unknown',
  Intent:d.intent || 'general',
  Question_Asked:d.queryText,
  Reason:d.escalationReason,
  AI_Confidence:d.answerConfidence ?? '',
  FAQ_Best_Score:d.faqBestScore ?? '',
  Status:d.escalationStatus,
  Assigned_To:'Sourcing Manager',
  Resolution_Notes:''
}}];

const d=$('Prepare Sourcing Escalation').item.json;
return [{json:{
  Interaction_ID:d.interaction_id,
  Timestamp:d.received_at,
  Session_ID:d.session_id,
  Question_Asked:d.queryText,
  Requestor_Type:d.requestorType || 'unknown',
  Intent:d.intent || 'general',
  Event_ID:d.resolvedEventId || d.eventIdHint || '',
  Event_Stage:d.eventStage || '',
  Route:'ESCALATED',
  FAQ_Best_Score:d.faqBestScore ?? '',
  FAQ_IDs_Used:(d.usedFaqIds||[]).join(', '),
  AI_Confidence:d.answerConfidence ?? '',
  Repeat_Question_Count:d.repeatQuestionCount ?? '',
  Was_Escalated:'Yes',
  Escalation_Reason:d.escalationReason,
  Answer_Given:d.final_response,
  Grounding_Note:'Human review required; no unsupported RFx answer was released.',
  final_response:d.final_response
}}];

parameters.content:
## Sourcing FAQ Assistant Workflow (Procurement Industry)

This n8n workflow provides a procurement-focused conversational assistant for answering RFx sourcing-event questions from suppliers and internal stakeholders.

RFx event data, approved FAQ rules, interaction history, escalations, knowledge gaps, and FAQ candidates are managed through Google Sheets. Google Gemini is used to classify the inquiry and generate a grounded answer from authorized context. Deterministic workflow logic resolves the authoritative RFx event and stage, filters FAQ content by audience, checks knowledge coverage, validates AI confidence and FAQ references, detects sensitive questions, and decides whether the workflow should answer, clarify, or escalate.

The workflow does not allow Gemini to independently decide what procurement information is authorized. Unsupported or sensitive questions are routed for human sourcing review, while repeated knowledge gaps can become FAQ candidates for manual review.

### Setup steps
1. Create one Google workbook with `RFx_Events`, `FAQ_Rules`, `FAQ_Usage_Log`, `Escalation_Log`, `Knowledge_Gap_Log`, and `FAQ_Candidate_Log`.
2. Open `Configure RFx Assistant` and set the `workbook_id` and `sourcing_manager_email`. Adjust the thresholds there if needed. No n8n Variables are required.
3. Connect Google Sheets, Google Gemini, and Gmail credentials.
4. Populate event and FAQ data, then test supplier, internal, ambiguous-event, sensitive, repeated-gap, and low-confidence scenarios.
5. Activate the workflow and use the n8n Chat URL.

## Intake & AI Classification

Captures and normalizes the RFx question, extracts deterministic hints, and uses Gemini to classify requestor type, intent, and sensitivity before procurement data is accessed.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Event and Policy Resolution

parameters.content:
## Event & Policy Resolution

Loads RFx events, approved FAQ rules, and interaction history. Validates classification and resolves the authoritative sourcing event and current stage from source data.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Authorized Retrieval and Demand

parameters.content:
## Approved Answer & Audit

Only answers that pass all guardrails reach this branch. The interaction, confidence, FAQ references, and grounding details are logged before the approved response is returned.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Grounded AI and Guardrails

parameters.content:
## Grounded AI & Guardrails

Gemini receives only the resolved event and authorized FAQ matches. Post-generation validation checks JSON structure, confidence, FAQ citations, restricted content, and model-requested human review before releasing an answer.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Audit Escalation and Response

parameters.content:
## Knowledge Gap & FAQ Improvement

Unsupported questions are logged as knowledge gaps. Historical demand identifies repeated gaps and creates proposed FAQ candidates for sourcing-team review instead of automatically publishing AI-generated knowledge.

## Safety Routing & FAQ Retrieval

Applies deterministic safety routing before answering. Approved FAQ content is filtered by event, stage, and audience, while historical usage identifies repeated questions and insufficient knowledge coverage.

## Safe Clarification

Ambiguous requestor identity, unresolved event IDs, or multiple possible RFx events trigger clarification instead of guessing. The clarification is logged before being returned to the user.

## Sourcing Manager Escalation

Sensitive questions, insufficient knowledge, and failed AI guardrails enter controlled human review. An escalation record is created and the sourcing manager is notified by email.

## Escalation Audit & Response

Records the final escalated interaction in the FAQ usage log and returns a safe notice confirming that sourcing-team review is required.
